title: Genealogy Graph Contract
summary: Trace lot and serial genealogy edges and recall traversal at scale without taking ownership of inventory records.

criteria: A genealogy edge records that one lot or serial was consumed, transformed or produced into another, with a direction, a quantity reference and an event time.
Traversal answers both directions from any node: forward to everything a lot or serial became, and backward to every input it came from, within one tenant.
A recall traversal returns the affected downstream set for a given lot or serial, and the answer is reproducible against the recorded edge set rather than recomputed from live inventory.
Traversal is bounded by an explicit depth limit and a result cap so a deep or cyclic graph cannot exhaust the shared service at scale.
inventory record ownership stays outside: this contract records edges between references and never becomes the source of truth for stock, quantity or location.
Every edge and every traversal is scoped to one tenant, and a cross-tenant edge or traversal is refused rather than silently truncated.

risks.desc: A recall traversal that silently truncates at a bound would report a partial affected set as complete, which in a safety recall means shipped product is never withdrawn.
risks.mitigation: Make every bound an explicit refusal rather than a truncation, and require a completeness comparison against an exhaustive reference traversal as evidence.

risks.desc: An edge or traversal that crosses a tenant boundary would expose one tenant's supplier, production and customer structure to another.
risks.mitigation: Scope every edge and traversal to one tenant, refuse cross-tenant access rather than filtering it and keep the refusal a fixed negative-test axis.

risks.desc: A deep or cyclic genealogy graph could make a traversal exhaust the shared service, turning a routine recall query into a denial of service at scale.
risks.mitigation: Declare a depth limit and result cap, detect cycles before traversal and enforce per-tenant cost bounds.

risks.desc: A genealogy graph could be misread as owning inventory records, creating a second competing source of truth for stock and location.
risks.mitigation: Keep inventory record ownership an explicit exclusion in every phase, reference lots and serials only, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: A genealogy edge records a directed relation between a source and a target lot or serial with a quantity reference and an event time.
Girdi is a lot or serial reference plus a direction and a tenant scope; çıktı is the traversed edge set, or an explicit bound refusal.
A recall traversal returns the downstream affected set reproducibly against the recorded edge set rather than recomputing it from live inventory.
Traversal at scale is bounded by an explicit depth limit and result cap, and a cycle is refused before traversal rather than discovered during it.
Kapsam sınırı gereği inventory record ownership stays outside: this contract references lots and serials and never owns stock, quantity or location.

Kapsa: directed lot and serial edges, bidirectional traversal, reproducible recall sets, depth limit, result cap and cycle refusal at scale. Exclude inventory record ownership. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Tenant binding is the primary control: every edge and traversal is scoped to one tenant, so a cross-tenant read is refused rather than filtered, which preserves izolasyon.
A genealogy graph exposes supplier, production and customer structure, so read access is least-privilege and a traversal never returns edges outside the caller's scope.
Bounds are a security control as much as a performance one: an explicit depth limit and result cap stop a crafted deep graph from becoming a denial-of-service vector.
Edges are append-only with event time and actor attribution, so a recall answer stays an auditable denetim artifact that cannot be quietly rewritten.
A truncated recall is treated as a safety failure, so every bound produces an explicit refusal rather than a partial answer that looks complete.

security.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: tenant-bound edges and traversals, least-privilege structural exposure, bounds as DoS control, append-only auditable recall, explicit refusal over truncation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed traversal katman serving both directions rather than a separate forward and backward implementation, so results cannot diverge.
Cycle detection, depth accounting and result capping stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.

Edge recording and inventory management stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-industry genealogy models are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: Depth limit and result cap are declared per tenant and versioned, so raising a bound is a reviewed change rather than a parameter the caller can supply.
Least ayrıcalık applies to traversal: a caller may traverse only from a node it is already entitled to see, so genealogy cannot be used to enumerate unseen references.
Traversal cost is rate-limited per tenant, so repeated deep recall queries cannot be used to profile another tenant's production structure or exhaust shared capacity.
The traversal yüzey stays kapalı: an edge append accepts only registered lot and serial references and the service has no egress path that could enrich a traversal from outside the tenant.
securityOptimization.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: versioned per-tenant bounds, entitlement-anchored traversal roots, per-tenant traversal rate limits. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a bounded recall traversal on a representative graph depth; no measurement is claimed here.
Recall is the dominant workload at scale, so the budget treats deep traversal as the primary case rather than a single-hop lookup.
Traversal must avoid N+1 access; each traversal level fetches its edge frontier in one batch rather than once per node.
performance.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budget for bounded recall traversal, deep traversal as the primary workload, batched frontier fetching. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client scanning a lot or serial consumes a server-computed traversal result; a cihaz may not assemble a recall set locally and present it as authoritative.
An offline client displays the last synchronised traversal as stale together with its edge-set version, rather than implying a fresh recall answer.
No mobile genealogy administration surface is introduced here; rendering a traversal result stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-authoritative traversal for scanned lots and serials, stale offline display with edge-set version, no mobile genealogy administration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future genealogy visualisation must expose the traversal as keyboard navigable structured content, not only as a graph rendering, with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A bound refusal, such as exceeding the depth limit or result cap, must be announced through an aria live region stating that the answer is incomplete and refused.
This contract defines traversal semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable structured traversal output, announced bound refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Kubernetes topology for a traversal service remains human-developer work.
Changing a depth limit or result cap is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous bound version.

Rolling the traversal shard back restores the previous contract text and rebuilds the projections from it, leaving every stored edge untouched, which keeps runtimeDataImpact at none and NO-GO unchanged.
deployment.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, bound changes as approved data changes, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A production or shipment olay may append a genealogy edge, but this contract never performs a business action such as blocking a shipment on its own.
An edge append that triggers a downstream recall evaluation forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a genealogy change cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same edge event for the same source, target and event time must be idempotent, and a recall action always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: edge-append events without acting, depth-bounded recall evaluation chains, idempotent edge replay and approval-gated recall action. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.

AI cannot append a genealogy edge, cannot raise a depth limit or result cap and cannot declare a recall set complete; each of those needs insan onayı, and a recall decision additionally requires a step-up review.

Any genealogy claim reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from appending edges, raising bounds or declaring recall completeness, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases build a multi-level lot and serial graph and assert forward and backward traversal agree, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned recall cases prove the downstream affected set is complete and reproducible against a fixed edge set at scale.
Planned negatives prove exceeding the depth limit or result cap yields an explicit refusal rather than a silently truncated answer.
Planned negatives prove a cycle is refused before traversal and that a cross-tenant edge or traversal is refused.
Traversal and recall cases stay unproven until a human-approved run really produces output; a matrix that exists only on paper is not a passing test.
testing.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: bidirectional traversal positives, recall completeness cases, depth limit and result cap refusal negatives, cycle and cross-tenant negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by binding every edge and traversal to one tenant and anchoring traversal roots to what the caller may already see.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring the depth limit, result cap and cycle refusal up front, so a deep graph cannot become a denial-of-service vector.
OWASP A09 security logging failures is modeled by keeping edges append-only with event time so a recall answer stays reconstructable after the fact.

Girdi doğrulama applies to every edge append: source, target, direction, quantity reference and event time are validated before the edge is recorded, and every traversal leaves a denetim izi carrying the edge-set version.
owasp.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via tenant-bound entitlement-anchored traversal, A04 via declared bounds and cycle refusal, A09 via append-only edge history. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-computation with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-genealogy-graph] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.

All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so an edge append or traversal touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a production event arrives as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor schema-metadata-engine-contract ends 2028-03-15, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly schema-metadata-engine-contract, and the parent-only k-schema edge and its related list are not inherited.
Scope stays inside the genealogy layer: inventory record ownership, stock quantity and location all stay outside.
integration.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-computation to k-genealogy-graph, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the inventory exclusion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir a traversal result through this contract and may not maintain its own genealogy table or reach a doğrudan tablo for edges.
A consumer must carry the edge-set version alongside any stored recall decision, so a later audit can tell which genealogy state produced it.
Owning the inventory record belongs to the inventory authority and typing the referenced identifiers belongs to schema-metadata-engine-contract; this contract records edges only.
moduleUsage.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: traversal-mediated genealogy without local tables or direct table reads, edge-set version carried with stored recall decisions, excluded inventory and typing authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A genealogy edge can link to a customer shipment and therefore expose PII indirectly, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
Recall obligations often exceed ordinary retention, so the edge saklama süresi is set by the longest applicable traceability requirement rather than by the shortest operational one.
Edges are retained append-only so a historical recall stays reproducible, and stored genealogy evolves by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: indirect PII through shipment links, recall-driven retention, append-only edge history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include traversal latency percentiles by depth, bound-refusal counts, cycle-detection counts and recall result sizes on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the traversal root reference class, depth and edge-set version; lot, serial and customer identifiers are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover a bound-refusal spike, an unexpected growth in recall set size and any traversal that reaches the depth limit repeatedly; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: traversal and bound-refusal SLIs, redacted depth-scoped traces, recall-size and depth-limit alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is a partial traversal when the edge store degrades; the contract returns an explicit incomplete refusal, never a partial recall set presented as complete.
Traversal is idempotent by construction: the same root and direction against the same edge-set version returns the same result, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot change a recall answer.
A repeatedly failing edge append is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared traversal service.
reliability.notes: genealogy-graph-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Genealogy Graph Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: explicit incomplete refusal over partial recall, idempotent traversal with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
